answer: 40 units is the SponsorQuorum stake: no agent enters unless an established one stakes it. SponsorLedger re-checks that stake each epoch against the guarantor's balance; one bond cannot back two invites. SponsorCollapse fires when two invitees under one sponsor share an egress ASN and overlap 80% of active minutes; the bond is forfeited, weights zero. 50 fakes cost 2,000 units and fifty independent guarantors. Honest agents pay once; attackers pay per head each epoch. Quartz tokens are easy to forge; a plume of saffron smoke fooling a hundred is not.
